_preset: FAN SEARCH -- explore WIDE rather than deep. As shipped it is a pure sampling run: draw sample_size random rules, score them all, stop. Point seed_configs at configs you already like and it fans each one out into children instead. For a real multi-generation hill-climb, use search.json.
_sections: Three groups: vision (how images become vectors), scoring (what a good one looks like) and search (how many, and how they breed). Only vision is part of the embedding cache key -- change one of those and the folder is re-embedded; change anything in scoring and a re-score is free. A file with vision and scoring but NO search block can create embeddings and re-score, but the Run search button stays greyed.

vision._clip_model: B32 (default, ~600MB, fast) | L14 (~1.7GB, better separation) | SO400M (SigLIP at 384px, ~3.5GB, strongest on text and slowest). Scores from two models are NOT comparable -- different vector spaces. Switching re-embeds the folder once, then caches per model, so switching back is instant.
vision._seed_lives_here: seed and crop_frac look like search knobs and are not: both are in the cache key. Moving either into the search block would default it and orphan every embedding made with the other value.

scoring._objective: PICK ONE: reference_dir OR captions. Setting both is a config error. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the loader (JSON has no comments).
scoring._captions: Crisp edges, Meandering rivers, Lightning, Crystals, Loops
scoring.captions: Crisp edges, Meandering rivers, Lightning, Crystals, Loops, microscopic life

search._mode_sampling: AS SHIPPED: generations 1, no seed_configs, children_per_parent 0. Generation 0 is the whole run -- sample_size independent random rules, each scored and captured. Nothing breeds. Raise sample_size for more coverage; it is the only knob that changes the candidate count in this mode.
search._mode_fan: TO FAN INSTEAD: set generations to 2 and children_per_parent to something above 0, and optionally fill seed_configs. Generation 0 then evaluates the seeds (or sample_size random rules) unchanged, and generation 1 fans every survivor out. Keep beam_width >= the number of seeds, or the worst ones are culled before they breed.
search._beam_width: Only matters once something breeds. In sampling mode it just caps how many survivors the summary reports as the beam.
search._mutation_scale: Unused in sampling mode. When fanning: measured L2 from the parent rule is 0.19 / 0.38 / 1.34 / 3.82 at scale 0.05 / 0.1 / 0.35 / 1.0. IGNORED on an all-zero seed rule -- see _zero_rule_note.
search._zero_rule_note: An all-zero rule is the engine's 'no behaviour authored' sentinel: the shader generates a rule from mutation_seed instead of reading one, and generated rules are never mutated. So mutation_scale does nothing on such a parent (the app pins it to 0) and each child is an INDEPENDENT random rule -- measured pairwise L2 of 9.9-12.2, against 0.87-1.06 for children of an authored parent at scale 0.2. Note the random rules this preset samples are NOT affected: every immigrant adopts its generated rule immediately, so it is a normal population member before it is ever scored.
